description: Target-agnostic preset morph engine: snapshot any OP's animatable parameters into N named slots, then blend between them with a weight vector (or a single A↔B recall) through a Lag CHOP + Lookup curve, exposing the live blended values on a Null CHOP for bind_to_channel consumers. Unlike create_look_bank (which is scoped to a control COMP's custom pars with a 2-slot A↔B knob), this drives any OP and supports >2 simultaneous weights (normalized internally). Reuses manage_cue's MORPH_HOOK for beat/bar quantized recall. Note: Lag CHOP does not advance while the timeline is paused.

action.description: build: create the morph container. store: snapshot the target's animatable parameters into a named slot. recall: snap or crossfade the target to one slot. set_weights: drive an N-way weighted blend across all stored slots (vector is clipped to >=0 and normalized). list / delete slots.

include.description: (store) Restrict the snapshot to these parameter names (tuplet names like 'tx', 'feedback'). Omit to capture every animatable numeric/toggle/menu parameter (pulses, strings, file refs are always skipped).

interpolation.description: Interpolation curve applied to each parameter when crossfading. linear is a straight lerp; cosine/cubic shape the lagged weights through a Lookup CHOP curve.

morph_seconds.description: (recall) 0 = snap; >0 = ease to slot over this many seconds via a Lag CHOP on the weight vector. Note: Lag CHOP does not advance while the timeline is paused.

name.description: Name of the morph container (baseCOMP) created inside parent_path.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the morph container is built.

quantize.description: (recall) Defer the snap/crossfade to the next musical boundary (project tempo). Mirrors manage_cue / create_look_bank.

slot.description: Slot name (required for store / recall / delete).

target_path.description: The node whose parameters are snapshotted and driven (required for build/store). Any OP with animatable numeric/toggle/menu pars.

weights.description: (set_weights) Map of slot-name -> weight. Negatives clipped to 0; the vector is normalized internally (sum -> 1) before lerp. Missing slots default to 0.

name: create_preset_morph
